task_description.overview: Compute and visualize the 2D frequency–wavenumber (FK) spectrum of the seismic section.
steps: Load the seismic Section object using daspy.read().
Call the Section.plot() method with obj set to 'fk' to specify an FK plot.
Pass kwargs_pro dict to customize the cosine taper coefficients and FFT output sizes.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Load the Section object via daspy.read({das_data_path}). Generate an FK spectrum plot by calling sec.plot(obj={obj}, kwargs_pro={kwargs_pro}). Display the resulting FK image using matplotlib. 
 Note: 1) Save the fk spectrum plot to {fk_spectrum_plot}.
